STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. I treated it as a circle for the area: 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- White rice
- Broccoli
- Fried tofu
- Grilled sliced meat (likely pork)
- Seared round pieces (likely scallops or chicken)
- Sprouts/onion
- Oil/sauce
